name: effort-change-between-turns-restarts-now-with-resume
description: Cycle Effort pressed while the session is idle between turns restarts the harness at once with the new effort, resuming the same session.
reason: With no turn in flight there is nothing to cut off, so waiting would only leave the next prompt running on the old effort.
source: DESIGN.md v1.2 E '.cycleEffort' ('Otherwise restart now with --resume current sessionID'); AppState.cycleEffort / restartForEffort

script.reason: App launch: a fresh session with effort low.
The session is ready and idle.
Low → Medium with no turn in flight: restart right away.
